_doc: Documented exceptions to check-cross-platform-paths.mjs (W.726 gate). `files`: path substrings whose whole file is exempt. `lines`: 'fileSubstr::codeSubstr' to exempt one finding. Keep SMALL — every entry is portability debt. The gate's forward value is via `--changed <ref>` (cloud-branch diffs) + catching NEW deployed-code hardcoded paths; these baselined entries are pre-existing/legitimate.
_baseline_note: All current packages/*/src findings are either (a) references to the air-gapped local GOLD drive (D:/GOLD — see S.GLD; GOLD_ROOT env is the override for non-Windows-local nodes incl. Jetson) or (b) non-executable display/example strings in docs/tutorials. GOLD endpoints are local-only by design. Cross-platform GOLD-root resolution (GOLD_ROOT || os-resolved default) is a tracked follow-up, not a deploy blocker.
